name: Shift Cyber Security Ltd. (Formerly Tectonic Security)

jobs.title: Solution
jobs.description: Shift Security Home Solution Use Cases Testimonials Careers Get a Demo TPRM Is Broken Your TPRM is leaving you blind to real-time data access, scope creep, and hidden AI risks. Finally, a platform built for the AI era: Assess True 3rd-Party Risk Map the Blast Radius & Analyze Threat Impact Enforce Policies & Minimize Exposure Start Here The Modern Exposure Reality Enterprises are rapidly evolving into a web of intertwined third-party solutions and AI dependencies. In this living ecosystem, hidden exposures take root in the undergrowth. What Your TPRM Is Missing: Unknown Access What resources and data is the vendor accessing? AI Blindspots What are vendor agents and LLMs doing in your environment? No Policy Enforcement Your TPRM Policies remain on paper (not operationalized). Shift Security provides agentic risk assessments, real-time activity monitoring, and continuous enforcement, across all 3rd, 4th and Nth-party solutions, to mitigate exposure, block supply chain attacks, and accelerate incident response. Agentic Vendor Risk Assessment Shift uses autonomous AI to continuously monitor third-party risk, replacing static, point-in-time reviews with real-time assessments. Safe AI Adoption Shift discovers all 3rd and Nth-party AI, continuously assessing its risk, access and behavior over time to securely enable your AI initiatives. Blast Radius Impact Analysis Shift maps the intertwined web of your solutions to analyze in real-time the potential impact of threats on your environment for effective response. Attack Surface Reduction Shift minimizes exposure and reduces your attack surface by automatically identifying over-permissioned and stale vendors in your environment. Agentic Access Policy Enforcement Shift is the first solution that lets you actively enforce vendor access policies that, until today, only existed on paper. Trusted by Security Leaders Unprecedented Visibility into Vendor Access "For the first time, enterprises can actually see which vendors have access to internal systems and sensitive data, monitor risky access changes in real time, and take immediate action. That's a game-changer." Samir Sherif Former CISO, F5 End-to-End Risk Reduction Across the Vendor Lifecycle "Shift brings proactive risk reduction to every phase of the third-party lifecycle - not just onboarding. It's security-first from discovery to offboarding." Oliver Newbury Former Global CISO, Barclays Built with Leading Partners Shift partners with forward-thinking industry leaders to reimagine how organizations discover, assessed, and manage third-party risk. Shift your perspective from passive assessment to active security and control. Thank you for your submission! Our team will contact you soon. Oops! Something went wrong while submitting the form.
